preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= c_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= d_i <= 10**9 for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates (a_i/b_i, c_i/d_i) have denominators and numerators between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of moves c is between 0 and n//2 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in moves)
postconditions.description: Each move consists of two distinct points a and b, each between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) not in moves for a, b in [(b, a) for a, b in moves])
postconditions.description: Each move (a, b) is unique and not repeated in reverse order (b, a).

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) not in moves for a, b in [(x, y) for i in range(len(moves)) for j in range(i + 1, len(moves)) for x in moves[i] for y in moves[j]])
postconditions.description: No point is used in more than one move.

postconditions.expression: all((new_x_a * new_y_b == new_x_b * new_y_a) for new_x_a, new_y_a, new_x_b, new_y_b in [(a_i + 1, c_i, b_i + 1, d_i), (a_i + 1, c_i, b_i, d_i + 1), (a_i, c_i + 1, b_i + 1, d_i), (a_i, c_i + 1, b_i, d_i + 1) for a_i, b_i, c_i, d_i in points for a, b in moves if a == i + 1 or b == i + 1])
postconditions.description: For each move (a, b), there exists a line passing through (0, 0), (new_x_a, new_y_a), and (new_x_b, new_y_b) after the move.
